Read docs/VALIDATION_STATUS.md, TEST_PLAN.md, and PUBLISH_FROM_MAC.md. Require real
Ubuntu build/test/runtime evidence and distinguish CI x86_64 from target ARM64.
Review package metadata, chosen license, source synchronization, staged-file
hygiene, limitations, and dates. List blockers and draft honest release notes
only from supplied evidence. Do not initialize Git, commit, upload, trigger CI,
or mark checks passed without logs. Release preparation is not publication.
